items.claim: Mason Jones has shown a big heart in his fights.
items.quote: him showing how big his heart is.

items.claim: Mark O. Medeiros is more technically sound than Mason Jones.
items.quote: Mark O. Medeiros is more technically sound than him.

items.claim: Mason Jones has improved his grappling, increasing his takedowns, fence pressure, and clinch work.
items.quote: mason Jones really up his grappling, really up the amount of takedowns he's shooting, the amount he's pushing into the fence, the amount he's trying to clinch you

items.claim: Mark O. Medeiros lost his fight against Taco Padilla.
items.quote: Mark O. Medeiros had a close one with Taco Padilla. Taco Padilla really did win that fight.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder's previous problem was gassing out and poor cardio against Brendan Allen.
items.quote: Reinier de Ridder's problem was that cardio, the gassing out against Brendan Allen.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder has an advantage in submission grappling over Roman Dolidze.
items.quote: He has an advantage there in submission grappling

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder has good knees on the feet, as shown by busting up Bo Nickal.
items.quote: I like Reinier's knees. I You know, you look back at that Bo Nickal performance where he's busting Bo Nickal up on the feet.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder is excellent at finding opponents' backs and wrapping his limbs around them.
items.quote: Reinier de Ridder finds the back a little bit better. I think he magnet He's a magnet to the back.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino throws big looping shots and is physically strong, but does not have unbelievable knockout power.
items.quote: Petrino throws looping big shots, and it's not like he has unbelievable knockout power.

items.claim: Sergey Spivak has a good jab and keeps his hands high with pretty good blocks.
items.quote: I like the jab of Sergey Spivak, and while Sergey Spivak does not have good head movement, he does have pretty good blocks. He keeps his hands pretty high.

items.claim: Sergey Spivak will have a sizable grappling advantage over Vitor Petrino on the ground.
items.quote: on the ground, we should be seeing a pretty sizable advantage for Sergey Spivak.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino has poor defensive striking and lacks great head movement.
items.quote: how's Vitor Petrino's defensive striking? Not great.
